# App Attest fixtures

The recorded attestation fixtures come from [uebelack/node-app-attest](https://github.com/uebelack/node-app-attest/tree/main/test/fixtures), under the included MIT license. They contain public test vectors and no private signing keys. Their leaf certificates expired in 2024 and 2025. Success tests use a fixed historical clock; production always checks the real clock.
